result.brief: 提出 OmniCam，从全景图与文本自回归生成相机位姿序列，用几何锚定的位姿 token 学习实现目标感知的相机轨迹控制，并构建 OmniCaT 数据集，服务于相机可控视频生成与机器人主动感知。
result.reason: Generates camera pose trajectories from panorama and text via geometry-grounded pose token learning, directly serving camera-controlled video generation and world-model conditioning.
